I. SAC-MAN SYSTEM CONVERSION INFORMATION SAFETY The following safety hints apply to all game operators and service personnel. Specific warnings and cautions will be found throughout this manual where they apply. WARNINGS AC POWER CONNECTION. Before connecting the game to the AC power source, verify that the proper voltage-selection plug is installed on the electronic chassis assembly. PROPERLY GROUND THE GAME. Customers may receive an electrical shock if this game is not properly grounded! To avoid shocks, do not plug in the game until it has been inspected and properly grounded. Sente game should only be plugged into a grounded 3-wire outlet. Customers may receive an electrical shock if the control panel is not properly grounded!. After servicing any parts on the panel, check that the grounding wires are secure. Only then should you lock up the game. DISCONNECT POWER DURING REPAIRS. To avoid electrical shock, disconenct the game from the AC power source before removing or repairing any part of the game. When removing or repairing the monitor, extra precautions must be taken to avoid electrical shock because high voltages may exist within the display circuitry and cathoderay tube (CRT) even after power has been disconnected. Do not touch internal parts of the display with your hands or metal objects! Always dis- charge the second anode from the CRT before servicing this area of the game. To discharge the CRT: attach one end of a large, well-insulated, 20-kY jumper to ground. Momentarily touch the free end of the grounded jumper to the anode by sliding it under the anode cap. Wait two minutes and discharge the anode again. USE THE PROPER FUSES. To avoid electrical shock, use replacement fuses which are specified in the parts list for this game. Replacement fuses must match those replaced in fuse type, voltage rating, and current rating. in addition, the fuse cover must be in place during game operation. HANDLE FLUORESCENT TUBE AND CRT WITH CARE. If you drop a fluorescent tube or CRT and it breaks, it may implode! Shattered glass can fly eight feet or more from the implosion. CAUTION PROPERLY ATTACH ALL CONNECTORS. Make sure that the connectors on each printed- circuit board (PCB) are properly plugged in. If they do not slip on easily, do not force them. A reversed connector may damage your game and void the war- ranty. 1-1

OLD UPRIGHT GAME TO SAC-MAN MAINFRAME CONYERSION PROCEDURE To convert your OLD UPRIGHT GAME to a SAC-MAN mainframe is not a difficult operation. Just follow each step and the illustrations given in each figure in this general information manual and also the NEW GAME ASSEMBLY OF INFORMATION SHEETS. Also refer to the wiring diagram(s) provided in the NEW GAME ASSEMBLY OF INFORMATION SHEETS. REMOVAL OF OLD GAME HARDWARE 1. Turn the power off to your game and disconnect it from its wall outlet. 2. Unlock and open Coin Mech door. 3. Unlock and remove rear access door. 4. Disconnect and remove all OLD GAME P.C. Boards and their mounting hardware and discard. 5. Remove OLD GAME'S attract Art (Header) & discard. Wote: Before removing old cabling, mark cable locations in game cabinet. Most of the corresponding new cabling (except for Master Cable Harness) should be routed as old cabling was unless noted otherwise. Therefore, leave all cable clamps where they are in game cabinet until new cabling is to be installed. At this point, please refer to NEW GAME ASSEMBLY OF INFORMATION SHEETS to complete OLD GAME HARDWARE removal procedure. INSTALLATION OF SAC-MAN HARDWARE NOTE: Please refer to NEW GAME ASSEMBLY OF INFORMATION SHEETS to complete SAC-MAN HARDWARE installation procedure. 1-3

SAC-MAN FIELD CONVERSION KIT GROUND STRAPPING PROCEDURE FOR FIELD CONVERSIONS Referring to Figure A, secure 3 large yellow Ground Straps to Transformer Power Chassis (as shown in figure) using 6-32 x 5/32" self-threading screw in a small hole in chassis. Secure shortest yellow Ground Straps of three to CPU Board Mtg. Plate (back side) as shown in Figure A using 6-32 hex nut fastened to 6-32 X 1 phil. screw. Secure shorter of two remaining Ground Straps to Power Supply and Audio Board Mtg. Plate as shown in Figure B using 6-32 hex nut fastened to 6-32 x 3/4" phil. rnd. hd. screw. Route long yellow Ground Strap up to the Coin Door area. Locate green/white #22 AWG ground wire (part of Master Cable Harness). Secure these along with a very short yellow Ground Strap and a 7" long black Ground Strap to weld stud on Coin Door frame (located on Coin Door's hinge side). Secure the two straps and wire with a 10-32 hex nut. Secure very short yellow Ground Strap to any stud or bolt on Control Panel. Secure strap to inside of Control Panel with nut already being used with stud or bolt. 7" Black Ground Strap is secured to Coin Door in one of two ways as follows: A. Remove screw securing any metal component to Coin Door. Place other end of the black Ground Strap between component and inside (bare metal area) of Coin Door and secure using the same screw. B. Use any available screw to secure end of black Ground Strap to inside (bare metal area) of Coin Door. The Monitor Assembly is to be grounded as follows: Locate a small hole (near the A.C. outlet) on Monitor Assembly's Chassis. There may or may not be a 6-32 or 8-32 self-threading screw in that hole (depending on your original game's cabinet). If there is not, then use the #6-32 X 5/32" slotted (w/washer) thread forming screw to secure green ground wire (part of Monitor Cable Assembly) to Monitor Assembly's Chassis.

SAC-MAN GAME CONVERSION INSTRUCTIONS The following instructions will cover the conversion of games used in SAC-MAN mainframes. These instructions apply to the SAC-MAN mainframe converted from your OLD GAME. Additional instructions will be provided, when needed, for special conversions. Each new game conversion kit used in the SAC-MAN mainframe should contain the following material: 1 control panel insert assembly 1 attract art 1 game cartridge with ROMS 1 option switch setting/game description sheet 1 control panel schematic If a new game conversion kit does not contain all of this material or if the material included is not for the correct game, contact your distributor.
